title.english: First day at a new job

intro: Written for this app: someone describes their first day at a new job, from nerves in the morning to friendly colleagues.

sentences.urdu: آج نئی نوکری پر میرا پہلا دن تھا۔
sentences.english: Today was my first day at my new job.

sentences.urdu: صبح اٹھتے ہی مجھے عجیب سی بےچینی محسوس ہونے لگی۔
sentences.english: As soon as I woke up, I started to feel a strange unease.

sentences.urdu: دفتر پہنچ کر میرے ہاتھ پاؤں پھول گئے کیونکہ وہاں سب لوگ اجنبی تھے۔
sentences.english: On reaching the office I panicked, because everyone there was a stranger.

sentences.urdu: لیکن میرے نئے ساتھی بہت مہربان نکلے اور انہوں نے میرا حوصلہ بڑھایا۔
sentences.english: But my new colleagues turned out to be very kind, and they encouraged me.

sentences.urdu: شام تک میرا اعتماد واپس آ گیا اور دل کو سکون ملا۔
sentences.english: By evening my confidence had come back and my heart was at ease.

sentences.urdu: گھر لوٹا تو میں خوشی سے پھولے نہ سما رہا تھا۔
sentences.english: When I got home, I was overjoyed.

اٹھتے: getting up (“uṭhte hi” = as soon as I got up)
پھول: swell (“haath paaon phool jaana” = to panic)
پھولے: swelled (“phoole na samaana” = to be overjoyed)

questions.urdu: صبح کس چیز کا احساس ہوا؟
questions.english: What did the narrator feel in the morning?

questions.urdu: دفتر میں ہاتھ پاؤں کیوں پھول گئے؟
questions.english: Why did the narrator panic at the office?

questions.urdu: ”ہاتھ پاؤں پھول جانا“ کا مطلب کیا ہے؟
questions.english: What does “haath paaon phool jaana” mean?
